backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing backend logic for events, tree adoption, user participation tracking, and serving two hardcoded blog posts about arid soil planting and mycorrhizae.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two completed features: removal of 'Caffeine AI' branding and addition of a contributors section with four team member names in the footer.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend component files, describing the Algeria reforestation website's structure, sections, and styling approach.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles defining OKLCH-based color system with custom design tokens for light and dark modes, including forest green and desert sand palette.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with page title 'Restoring Algeria's Green Heart' and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component orchestrating the single-page layout with Header, nine content sections (Hero through Blog), and Footer.
frontend/src/components/Blog.tsx: Educational resources section displaying two selectable blog post cards that fetch full content from the backend actor using React Query.
frontend/src/components/Crisis.tsx: Section detailing Algeria's deforestation crisis with four threat categories (wildfires, climatic stress, human impact, soil erosion) presented in styled cards with icons and imagery.
frontend/src/components/ExecutiveSummary: Introductory section with three statistic cards explaining Algeria's geographic diversity, 4.1 million hectare forest cover, and dual conservation mission.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying Algeria Green Initiative branding, quick navigation links to page sections, social media icons (Facebook, X, Instagram), copyright notice, and a contributors section listing team members.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed header component with Algeria Green Initiative branding (leaf icon and title) and navigation buttons that smooth-scroll to Crisis, Solutions, Get Involved, and Learn More sections.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Full-screen hero section with Atlas Mountains background image, headline about restoring Algeria's forests, call-to-action buttons for 'Take Action Now' and 'Learn More', and an animated scroll-down indicator.
frontend/src/components/NationalPlan.tsx: Section showcasing Algeria's National Reforestation Plan with three cards highlighting the ambitious goal, decade-long timeline, and focus species, plus a list of priority tree species (Aleppo Pine, Cork Oak, Holm Oak).
frontend/src/components/Solution.tsx: Section describing the Green Dam (Le Barrage Vert) project with an aerial image and four stat cards showing its 1,500km length, 1970s origin, biological shield function, and climate impact.
Grid showcase of three key Algerian forest species (Aleppo Pine, Atlas Cedar, Cork Oak) with images, badges indicating status/value, scientific names, and descriptions of their ecological and economic importance.
frontend/src/components/UrbanGreening.ts: React component displaying information about Algeria's urban greening initiative, including green ratio laws, heat island mitigation, and focus cities like Algiers and Oran. Uses Lucide icons and styled cards to present the content.
React component providing a volunteer portal with tabs for signing up to planting events and adopting trees. Uses React Query mutations to interact with the backend actor and displays toast notifications for user feedback.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Invalidates and refetches dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Custom React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle. Exports context provider and hook for accessing authentication state throughout the app.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file defining Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for the design system using OKLCH color space. Includes theme colors (forest green, desert sand), dark mode variants, and custom scrollbar styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component. Imports global styles and configures the provider hierarchy.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom colors (forest-green, desert-sand), OKLCH color system integration, container settings, and custom animations. Includes plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state file tracking a reforestation awareness website for Algeria with features including hero section, crisis explanation, Green Dam project showcase, volunteer portal, educational blog, and forest species information. Uses Deep Forest Green/Desert Sand color scheme with sustainable modern design aesthetic and multi-language support.
